query:
SELECT cp.id as client_profile_id, cp.interviewStatus, cp.viaStatus, cp.ipipStatus,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) as achievement_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT im.id) as interview_message_count
FROM client_profiles cp
LEFT JOIN achievements a ON a.clientId = cp.id
LEFT JOIN interview_messages im ON im.clientId = cp.id
WHERE cp.id IN (870001, 870002)
GROUP BY cp.id, cp.interviewStatus, cp.viaStatus, cp.ipipStatus;
